# Storage access denied
When a copy activity returns 403 Forbidden, check the managed identity role assignments. Confirm Storage Blob Data Contributor on the intended container. Check firewall and private endpoint configuration. Record the failing activity and correlation ID before escalation.

# Pipeline timeout
For pipeline timeout errors, inspect integration runtime capacity and activity concurrency. Review source query performance, network latency, and retry settings. Reduce the batch size before scaling capacity.

# Missing records
When row counts differ, compare source and target keys. Review ingestion watermark filters and rejected-record logs. Confirm the expected partition range before reprocessing. Never rerun a non-idempotent load without a rollback plan.
